text: The executive power, in this flatre, hath a right to a negative in parliament, i. e. to refe affien to any able others, otherwise the two other branches of legitimate power would, or might, become deloptic.

parsed.faithful: The executive power, in this flate, hath a right to a negative in parliament, i. e. to refufe affent to any acts offered; otherwife the two other branches of legiflative power would, or might, become defpotic.
parsed.modern: The executive power, in this state, hath a right to a negative in parliament, i. e. to refuse assent to any acts offered; otherwise the two other branches of legislative power would, or might, become despotic.
